'''Darvis Tret''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] sent to investigate the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] during the [[Rebellion era]]. After six months of observation, he recommended, in his report, to seize and occupy the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Derilyn]], and establish a naval base there. Lieutenant Tret got promoted shortly after the occupation of Derilyn for his accurate report.
